description: During boot, Master searched for Desktop Commander (mcp__Control_your_Mac__osascript) and OmniFocus MCP tools via ToolSearch, got no results, and concluded they were unavailable in this session/environment ('Claude Code environment, not Cowork'). David corrected: Desktop Commander is always available, and OmniFocus is now online and accessible. Master reported a false data gap in the boot briefing instead of exhausting search strategies or asking.
correction: Desktop Commander is always available for Mac filesystem/OmniFocus operations regardless of apparent session type. OmniFocus is now online. Do not declare a tool unavailable from a single ToolSearch miss.
systemic_fix: Before declaring any standing tool (Desktop Commander, OmniFocus MCP) unavailable, run multiple ToolSearch query variants and/or attempt a direct call before concluding absence. SYSTEM.md already warns against conflating 'not in my current bash mount' with 'not reachable at all' (err-20260715T134820-X2GOL2) — this is the same failure pattern applied to MCP/tool discovery instead of filesystem paths.
